<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/get_node_files"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the contents of every file belonging to a node: its main.lua
entry point (if present) plus any other loose files found directly in the
node's directory, such as sample data files. The node's own configuration
is excluded. Raises 404 if the node cannot be found.
